title: 1.2 Two people, different days
unit_outcome: Explain a working day, compare two people’s commitments, check assumptions and account for a change of routine.
goal: Report two people’s commitments and explain the contrast that matters for a shared plan.
grammar_function: Extend a productive system in service of reporting another speaker’s information. A contrast changes who can participate; a third-person ending is not the lesson’s whole purpose.
prerequisite: 1.1 schedule chunks and personal time questions A1 names, he/she, and; known goes is support
speaking_outcome: Natural /s/, /z/ and the extra syllable in finishes; audible but within an intelligible contrast.
